items.heading: Pepian
details: Key ingredients: chicken, tomato, pumpkin seeds, sesame seeds, chili
Toast pumpkin seeds, sesame seeds and dried chilies until fragrant.
Blend the toasted seeds with tomato and spices into a smooth sauce.
Simmer chicken pieces in the sauce until tender.
Serve the deep, nutty stew with rice.

items.heading: Chiles Rellenos Guatemaltecos
details: Key ingredients: poblano peppers, ground beef, egg, tomato sauce
Roast and peel poblano peppers, then stuff them with seasoned ground beef.
Dip the stuffed peppers in whisked egg.
Fry until the egg coating is golden and set.
Simmer briefly in a light tomato sauce before serving.
